itemized.notes: 4-page filing, standard shape: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B; both schedules print 'Page 1 of 1'. Unusually clear hand - the cleanest filing in this chunk. Contributions consist solely of TWO CANDIDATE SELF-LOANS: the name cell on both rows reads 'Jennifer Wilson' with '(Loan)' written beneath it inside the same cell, and the occupation cell reads 'Council Member, SLCO'; the form has no loan column, so the parenthetical is retained inside donor_raw rather than dropped or promoted to a field that does not exist. The 'Complete Mailing Address' column is entirely blank on p3 - filer omission, not redaction, so donor_city/donor_state are blank. Expenditures are a year of $4.00 monthly Network Solutions web-hosting charges plus one $64.00 Wells Fargo bank fee; note the filer records no August and no November web charge, which is the record as filed and was not interpolated. Header 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE' is the pre-printed form's own typo, present on every filing of this vintage.
